fact: The Referentiel general d'interoperabilite (RGI), a normative document fixing the rules for compatibility between public administrations' information systems, was adopted by arrete of the Prime Minister on 23 May 2018, as reported by Burkina 24 on 15 October 2019.
Burkina Faso says its regulatory framework includes a general interoperability framework (referentiel general d'interoperabilite).
